ranking_metric: combined catalog pagination.total minus shared-world catalog pagination.total; item/enchant/scope group-count proxy, not stock listing quantity
time_variation_limitations: Per-pair totals are from adjacent live responses, not one atomic snapshot.
Winner-world followup reuses that world response; reference age seconds is recorded for each additional server.
First-page local quantity sums are partial and never used as complete stock-listing counts.
